body.message:
Good afternoon, Samy,

I hope you’re doing well.

We would like to inform you that the property owner has requested a brief viewing of the apartment.

Would it be convenient for you to accommodate the viewing today, 3rd September, at 6:00 PM? Kindly let us know if this time works for you.

The viewing will be brief, and we truly appreciate your cooperation and understanding.

Thank you.
